heading: Read how the paint was made
first_line: Paint by Moonlight turns any photo into a paint-by-numbers picture, and its Marginarium chapters tell how Paul and his AI agents made it.
content_why: One passage and one picture per chapter keeps the page short and warm, and lets a visitor meet each chapter's voice without reading the whole long night at once.
avoid: Avoid badges, banners and slick taglines that dress the page up before the paint is there.
